body.content:
_Roz subah se raat tak WhatsApp pe price, photo aur availability ke 20-100 messages — aur manually har ek ka jawab dena padta hai_. 😓

Jaipur ke saree aur lehenga shops ke liye humne ek WhatsApp AI Sales Assistant banaya hai jo aapki jagah kaam karta hai —
_live 24/7_, bina kisi staff ke.

Ye kya karta hai:
📸 Catalog photos aur pricing — 10 seconds mein auto-reply
🛍️ Orders aur bookings directly WhatsApp pe confirm karta hai
🗣️ Hindi aur Hinglish mein baat karta hai, bilkul natural
🚀 Sales 50% tak badhegi  

_Pehle 7 din bilkul FREE — uske baad sirf ₹3,000 for first month._
Koi setup cost nahi. Koi contract nahi.
👉 Reply karein DEMO — hum aapke shop ke liye ek live demo dikhayenge, seedha aapke WhatsApp pe.
